findings.description: The async OR operator flattens a left-hand retry_all into retry_any, changing conjunctions into disjunctions. The type check should target retry_any.
findings.rationale: For async retry_all(a, b) | retry_any(c), where a returns true and b and c return false, this branch constructs retry_any(a, b, c). The expression consequently returns true instead of false, causing an operation to be retried when the configured conditions reject retrying.
